sourceTruth.rule: All product outcomes, operations, guards, UI semantics, journeys, scenario steps and media recording requirements come from current source-pinned PDP-0 to PDP-3; this file is a replaceable Build execution projection and editorial overlay, never a normative duplicate.

selectionPolicy.earliestEligible: The earliest actually implemented customer-valuable source-governed business terminal in Media OR an authorized product consumer may be recorded, provided target-product semantics/receipts and Media PDP0-3 recorder authority both resolve. Never gate a ready Gharbatai/TutorPutor customer film on the unrelated Media J03 STT vertical.
selectionPolicy.allowedFallback: A different source-defined business journey can become the first film only after its own terminal postcondition and recorder admission pass; record exact changed source refs and owner decision rather than silently relabeling an upload or technical smoke test.
selectionPolicy.noCrossJourneyFinality: J-03 is a reviewable caption version; this profile does not claim reviewer approval (J-21), exported delivery or remote publishing (J-22), or product release.
selectionPolicy.firstChannelCompletionRule: Every normative step and customer terminal result implemented through one declared real channel with applicable failure/UNKNOWN recovery. Other J03 channels and full V03 remain open for independent Build parity.

candidateScopes.trigger: real Media customer terminal on one declared channel + recorder ready

candidateScopes.sourceAuthority: Target product's current normative business goal/requirements/operations/interface/journey sources; prefer PDP-0..3 where authored, require validated source-to-result binding
candidateScopes.recordingAuthority: Media recorder PDP-0..3; target product adapter owns actions, fixtures and business finality
candidateScopes.trigger: target product real terminal business postcondition and exact own receipts + Media recorder adapter ready; Media J-03 is NOT required

firstCandidate.title: From authorized audio recording to corrected reviewable captions
firstCandidate.endUserOutcome: A creator/editor can work from a real verified source, receive actual transcription, correct words/timing, register and inspect a reviewable immutable caption version with source/language/timing/provenance/uncertainty.

recorderReuse.adopter: Media-owned source-bound adapter; Gharbatai stories/data/demo drivers do not migrate
recorderReuse.qualification: Pinned private source-composite permitted for local development only after packed/export consumer tests, license/security admission, Playwright/browser isolation and actual product-effect receipt comparison. Not proof of published production dependency.

storyboard.policy: Editorial beats only. Generate actionable commands, selectors and expected finalities from source-authoritative PDP1/PDP2/PDP3 bindings. Never hardcode route, CSS selector, undocumented command or new product semantics in this file.

narration.productDraft: This recording follows the actual product workflow that turns a source audio recording into corrected, reviewable captions. Only outcomes verified in this run are presented.
narration.reviewRule: Mode-specific draft is not evidence; compare against actual recorded Explorer/product state, revise text as necessary and render voice with aligned subtitles only after source-current checks

admission.sourceDefinedScopeRule: Product prerequisite package IDs name authoritative component owners; their end-to-end outcome *subtasks* for the chosen actual source-authorized channel, not whole-package multi-channel completion, are the first-film prerequisite. Full package dependencies remain in canonical plan. F-READY and Kernel stage admission still apply. External product first-film path uses its own target-product package/business prerequisites; Media V01/V02/V20/V03 are NOT prerequisites unless recording those Media journeys.

productPrerequisiteAcceptance.M-BLD-V01: REAL SOURCE-AUTHORIZED CHANNEL PROJECT/IDENTITY RESULT; FULL PACKAGE MAY REMAIN OPEN
productPrerequisiteAcceptance.M-BLD-V02: REAL VERIFIED SOURCE VERSION AND METADATA; OTHER CHANNELS MAY REMAIN OPEN
productPrerequisiteAcceptance.M-BLD-V20: DURABLE SAME-JOB OBSERVATION AND RECONCILIATION ON FILMED CHANNEL
productPrerequisiteAcceptance.M-BLD-V03: REAL QUALIFIED STT, CORRECTED CAPTION VERSION AND PDP3 TERMINAL READBACK ON ONE SOURCE-AUTHORIZED CHANNEL; FULL V03 ALL-CHANNEL PARITY MAY REMAIN OPEN
productPrerequisiteAcceptance.M-BLD-L01: ONLY T01-T04 QUALIFIED FOR FIRST FILM; GENERAL MODALITY/DEVICE/STREAM CAPTURE REMAINS OPEN

dataAndQuality.fixtureProfile: Synthetic, consented, licensed test audio with intelligible phrases and intentional correctable timing/text mistakes; real media bytes processed through a real admitted STT engine, not a prerecorded transcript posed as inference.
dataAndQuality.fixtureProvisioning: Idempotent isolated demo tenant/workspace; deterministic seed identifiers; ownership/lease-scoped cleanup of only generated resources; avoid arbitrary database resets.
dataAndQuality.capture: PDP-3 captures the real running Explorer UI or headless projection against centrally mocked static fixtures, explicitly labeled SIMULATED; BUILD captures an admitted real product host or actual structured channel. Each mode records audible narration and captions. Explorer footage never proves live product effects.
dataAndQuality.privacy: No passwords/tokens/customer recordings/PII/biometric samples in output frames, logs, narration or bundle; consent and license verified for soundtrack, fonts and source content.
dataAndQuality.quality: Sound, framing, pacing, captions, accessibility, artifacts and visual continuity measured against owner-approved profile; no invented thresholds; crop/annotation or AI polish may not hide denied/UNKNOWN states.
dataAndQuality.narration: Declarative storyboard/captions with human review or qualified TTS; narration must follow observed output and may be manually edited without affecting business-source receipts.
dataAndQuality.automaticReRecording: On source/product UI changes, compare semantic and visual anchors to invalidate only affected scenes while preserving approved manual edits and immutable old film versions.
dataAndQuality.approvalBoundary: Recording may be captured after conditions are met; 'APPROVED_FILM' requires real file inspection and reviewer disposition; no film or external publication is currently approved.

successPolicy: TWO_PASS_TARGET: PDP3 records narrated Explorer simulated scenario with static seeded data; Build replays and records the same scenario against the real product when its actual business outcome works. Historical phase DEV_COMPLETE does not prove new Explorer video. Do not delay already-ready Build outcomes for unrelated scenario backfill.

scenarioIdentity.semanticsAuthority: Current PDP-0..3 sources only; this is a derivative identifier, not a new P0 capability or normative operation

dualStageRecording.sourceOfTruth: One source-owned PDP-3 scenario/fixture/ordered-step/narration intent; Build only substitutes real adapters, data and observations. Media recorder capability semantics are independently governed by Media PDP-0..3.

passes.dataBinding: Central, deterministic, realistic seeded frontend state and scenario action reducer; source-defined denial/UNKNOWN/recovery; no live login/upload/STT/provider

passes.host: Owner-admitted real product GUI or source-declared actual CLI/API/embedded channel
passes.fixtureAuthority: Owner-scoped, idempotent real seed and cleanup; illustrative Explorer IDs must be semantically resolved, not used as runtime IDs
passes.dataBinding: Actual persistent source digest, authenticated tenant/principal, admitted STT provider execution, authoritative transcript/caption/version receipts

dualStageRecording.explorerBadgeText: Simulated Explorer experience — illustrative data, no live product operations
dualStageRecording.productBadgeText: Recorded from actual product execution — exact result/authority proof required
dualStageRecording.narrationRule: Actual audio plus synchronized captions for both tracks; share intent/chapters, never a false completed-effect statement in PDP3 Explorer or ahead of Build owner receipt

semanticComparison.expectedBehavior: P0 customer goal/P1 guards and finality/P2 interaction/P3 steps+positive+denial+UNKNOWN+recovery must match, while runtime IDs, visuals and elapsed times can legitimately differ
semanticComparison.terminalProof: Mock scenario may show the designed caption terminal; only Build receipt proves a real immutable caption version was registered

dualStageRecording.recapture: Invalidate only affected shared scenes or one mode's footage based on semantic/source/fixture/host/narration fingerprint; preserve previous immutable records and manual edits
dualStageRecording.historicalState: All four PDP phase status records are pre-standard development evidence; none proves the new PDP3 narrated recording requirement
